answer: Require stake-backed reputation that only grows through verified work: an agent locks a refundable deposit and must complete small checkable jobs before handling valuable tasks, so each fake identity costs real money and time instead of being free to copy. Reputation works like a trellis, with every verified job adding a rung that later work climbs, while a sable-dark swarm of fresh throwaway accounts stays at ground level. One polished sonnet of self-praise cannot substitute for that auditable history.
